title: Controller self-test failure
shortDescription: Main controller failed self-test at boot.
fullDescription:
Dell laser and MFP printers show 001-002 when the main controller's self-test fails during boot. This is an unrecoverable state on consumer models.

Power cycling occasionally clears transient memory glitches; persistent cases require controller replacement.

On Dell-branded units (many are rebadged Lexmark or Xerox), follow the matching OEM troubleshooting path.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug printer for 5 minutes, then power on.

whenToCallPro: If power cycle does not help.

faq.a: On low-end Dell models replacement is often cheaper.

title: Fuser unit failure
fullDescription:
Dell 010-397 is a fuser failure code. The fuser could not heat to ready temperature, usually due to a failed lamp.

Replace the fuser maintenance kit with a Dell-genuine part.

Many Dell MFPs share fusers with Xerox or Lexmark — confirm the part number carefully.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuser kit
fixSteps.instruction: Install Dell maintenance kit including fuser.

faq.q: Do I need the full kit?
faq.a: Yes — Dell sells fuser as part of the maintenance kit.

title: Print job memory overflow
shortDescription: Not enough memory to process job.
fullDescription:
016-799 indicates the print job exceeded available memory on the Dell MFP. Complex PDFs or high-resolution images are typical triggers.

Reduce print resolution, simplify the document, or add optional printer memory.

Updating the PCL/PostScript driver helps reduce memory demand.

fixSteps.title: Reduce resolution
fixSteps.instruction: Lower print resolution in driver to 600dpi.

fixSteps.title: Update driver
fixSteps.instruction: Install latest Dell driver from support site.

faq.a: Some Dell models accept a memory upgrade module.

title: Tray size mismatch
shortDescription: Loaded paper size differs from tray setting.
fullDescription:
024-946 flags a mismatch between the paper size configured in the menu and the actual paper loaded.

Adjust either the guides to match the stored size or update the menu setting to match the paper.

Occurs on Dell Fuji-Xerox-sourced devices most commonly.

fixSteps.title: Check guides
fixSteps.instruction: Slide guides to touch the paper edges.

fixSteps.title: Update menu
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm tray paper size in printer menu.

faq.a: No, the job will not start until resolved.

title: Paper jam in fuser
fullDescription:
077-100 indicates a paper jam inside the fuser. Let the fuser cool for 10 minutes before attempting to remove the sheet.

Never force a sheet — paper wrapping the fuser roller can damage it.

Recurring jams here point to worn fuser or curled paper.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Wait 10 minutes for fuser to cool.

fixSteps.title: Remove paper
fixSteps.instruction: Open fuser area and gently pull paper.

faq.a: Inspect for dents or torn roller surface after removal.

title: Toner cartridge empty
fullDescription:
093-912 on Dell printers indicates the toner cartridge is fully depleted. Unlike a warning, this is a hard stop in most cases.

Replace with Dell OEM toner. Aftermarket toners occasionally bypass chip detection but may not give accurate levels.

Shake the cartridge before installing for best results.

fixSteps.title: Install new toner
fixSteps.instruction: Replace with Dell OEM toner cartridge.

faq.q: Can I shake and get more prints?
faq.a: Briefly, but a hard stop will return.

title: Transfer belt unit error
fullDescription:
094-318 indicates the Dell color printer's transfer belt unit needs replacement or has a hardware fault.

The belt unit is a user-replaceable consumable on most Dell color models; install a fresh one and reset the counter if prompted.

fixSteps.title: Replace belt
fixSteps.instruction: Remove old belt unit and install new Dell belt.

whenToCallPro: If new belt does not clear the code.

title: SMTP server connection failure
shortDescription: Scan-to-email could not connect to SMTP.
fullDescription:
116-314 is a scan-to-email connectivity error. The Dell MFP could not reach the configured SMTP server.

Verify server address, port (587 or 465 typical), SSL/TLS settings, and authentication credentials.

Modern Gmail and Outlook require app passwords, not regular passwords.

fixSteps.title: Verify settings
fixSteps.instruction: Open web admin and check SMTP server, port, SSL, and credentials.

fixSteps.title: Generate app password
fixSteps.instruction: For Gmail/Outlook create an app-specific password.

whenToCallPro: Only if corporate SMTP server is misconfigured.

faq.q: Why does Gmail not accept my password?
faq.a: Enable 2FA and use an app password.

title: System hang recovery
shortDescription: Firmware detected a hang and reset.
fullDescription:
900-009 on Dell devices indicates the firmware watchdog detected a hang and reset the device. A log entry is generated but the device continues.

Occasional 900-009 can be ignored. Frequent occurrences indicate a firmware bug — update to the latest firmware.

faq.a: Active jobs may be lost; stored data is not.

title: Main fan failure
fullDescription:
042-325 indicates the main cooling fan inside the Dell printer is not spinning. Dust accumulation or bearing failure is typical.

The printer will not operate without cooling to prevent overheating damage.

Technician cleans or replaces the fan.
whenToCallPro: If vacuuming does not restore fan rotation.

faq.q: Can I still use the printer briefly?
